title: deploy-script.test.ts times out under heavy machine load
acceptance: apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts passes reliably on a loaded machine: the slow case gets an explicit timeout with headroom, or the work it waits on is made faster, without weakening what it checks.
nextAction: Agent-created (Neo, 2026-11-23) at the close of round 1123 from web Lane 1's report. Backlog until the owner sets Ready. Seen once: 5.9 s against the 5 s default while the Neo's load average was 150 to 220; it passed on rerun. CI on #790 was green.

evidence.summary: While verifying #790 locally, pnpm test failed once on a timeout in apps/api/src/lib/deploy-script.test.ts (5.9 s against 5 s) under heavy machine load; the rerun at load 29 passed (web 1827, API 698, music 30). #790 changes no API code.
